source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: Natural numbers ℕ: 1, 2, 3, ...; integers ℤ: naturals, their opposites and 0; rationals ℚ: numbers m/n with m ∈ ℤ, n ∈ ℕ.
stages.headlineEnglish: Natural numbers ℕ: 1, 2, 3, ...; integers ℤ: naturals, their opposites and 0; rationals ℚ: numbers m/n with m ∈ ℤ, n ∈ ℕ.

stages.headline: Sums and products of naturals are natural, differences need not be; with rationals all four operations (except division by 0) give rationals.
stages.headlineEnglish: Sums and products of naturals are natural, differences need not be; with rationals all four operations (except division by 0) give rationals.

stages.headline: A rational number has infinitely many fraction forms: 1/2 = 2/4 = 3/6; the irreducible one has coprime numerator and denominator.
stages.headlineEnglish: A rational number has infinitely many fraction forms: 1/2 = 2/4 = 3/6; the irreducible one has coprime numerator and denominator.
